app.name: Fama AI
login.title: Sign in
login.body: Sign in with your famashines account.
login.errorUnreachable: Cannot reach the login server. Check the connection and try again.
login.errorFailed: Sign-in did not complete. Try again.
lock.title: Fama AI is locked
lock.body: Unlock with your fingerprint, face or device PIN.
lock.failed: Unlock did not complete. Try again.
lock.signOutFailed: Sign-out did not complete. Try again.
settings.noScreenLock: This device has no screen lock, so the app cannot lock. Set a screen lock in the device settings.
login.refused: The server did not accept your sign-in. Sign in again.
login.ended: Your session ended. Sign in again.
budget.noCap: No cap is set. The agents cannot call a model until you set a cap.
budget.saved: The cap is saved. The view updates in a moment.
budget.invalid: Write an amount from 0 to 1000000 USD, for example 5.00.
budget.softAbove: The soft cap must not be above the monthly cap.
budget.failed: The cap is not saved. Try again.
budget.rejected: The server did not accept this cap.
budget.grouping: A dot or comma with exactly three digits after it is not clear. Write 1000 for one thousand USD, or 1.00 for one USD.
chat.modelNeeded: Choose a model to send a message.
chat.modelHint: Opens the list of models and effort levels.
chat.modelsError: The model list did not load.
chat.cut: The answer reached the length limit.
chat.errorBudget: The budget does not allow this message.
chat.errorTooLong: This chat is too long. Start a new chat.
chat.errorRateLimited: Too many messages. Wait, then try again.
chat.errorUnauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
chat.errorFailed: The model gave no answer. Try again.
chat.greeting: What do you want to know?
chat.starter1: Explain a difficult idea in simple words
chat.starter2: Write a clear email for me
chat.starterHint: Puts this text in the message field.
